passages.title: Adult Sports League
paras: Teams must complete registration by 31 March. League matches take place on Thursday evenings.
Every team must nominate a person responsible for first-aid arrangements. Players are required to wear shirts in their team's agreed colours.

Teams split the referee fee equally. Final league standings are published on the league website.

passages.title: Workplace Annual Leave Policy
paras: Employees request annual leave using the staff portal. Where possible, leave should be requested at least four weeks in advance.
Managers consider team coverage before approving leave. Unused leave may not be carried into the next year in every circumstance.
Sickness absence is managed under a separate reporting process. The system sends an email when a leave request is approved or declined.
Public holidays are recorded separately from annual leave balances. Employees should speak directly with their manager about urgent changes.
